name: AI D3 - ATS detect
description: Self-draining careers page scan: ATS provider and token, careers URL, competitor mentions, saved via intel_save_page_scan.

parameters.content:
## D3 - ATS detect and page signals
Self-draining: every 15 min it takes up to 250 unscanned accounts (intel_accounts_to_scan marks the attempt), fetches the homepage, finds the careers link, fetches that if no ATS was seen yet, and saves ats_provider / ats_token / careers_url / competitor mentions via intel_save_page_scan.

When the load step returns nothing the run is a no-op. Unpublish once the whole book is scanned; re-run monthly.
